purpose: Interactive Fiction Weaver compilation of a Zyphos branch-and-fold resource allocation dispute from rotating caretaker Tesh's local perspective, with material scarcity, family standing, dependent-care priority, and ecological co-authority kept visible.

local_awareness_summary.text: Tesh knows the feeding apron's routine, current stores, public draw schedule, visible road, tree, mat, and herd signals, and the offered archive layers; Tesh does not know any partner's private intention.

The scene begins during ordinary first-return work while Umbros releases the dim sun; a scheduled reproductive draw later collides with an increased dependent-care draw and an incomplete mineral contribution.
Tesh's authority is declarative and scheduling authority only. The living partners separately control the material channels that make a draw possible.

frame_controls.text: Playable perspective remains Tesh's embodied Sa'auei'a viewpoint at a low circular work rail. Choices use two chest hands, facial fans, four-legged movement, archive membranes, route cords, visible ecological signals, and spoken declarations.
Routine contribution precedes shortage; the story establishes how the pulse is made before asking who receives it.

authority_boundaries.text: Tesh can record, schedule, request, transfer, and refuse. Tesh cannot command the fungal road, lantern trees, prismwake mat, or glassback herd to contribute.
Existing debt cannot by itself deny infant or infirm care. Actual capacity can still fail, and elective draws can be delayed.

object_custody.text: Varo retains the family archive except for a voluntarily opened rescue layer; Oru stewards the commons archive; Tesh handles public draw tokens, sealed salt, clean rejected graft tissue, route cords, and basin valves.

required_semantics.text: The pulse niche is an overlap of timed relationships, not one fungible commodity. Every successful allocation must name the material contributors and the repair cost.
The fixture must show route-rich family standing as real productive capacity and real class advantage without turning Varo into a cartoon hoarder.

forbidden_resolutions.text: Do not let a caretaker's declaration manufacture ecological consent, erase a missing material input, or become private ownership of the commons.
Do not make shared obligation valid without visible consent, or make reputation substitute for energy and matter.

branch_and_fold_plan.summary: Three choice layers fold through one feeding-apron pulse shortfall and select one of eight state-gated allocation endings.

branches.actor_intent: Feed a clean failed graft to the fungal road and establish material credit before draws begin.
state_basis: Candle roads digest failed grafts and exchange useful minerals under remembered terms.
Caretakers must declare handling history rather than present waste as tribute.
reviewed_consequences: Raises road_credit, salt_stock, and caretaker_legitimacy; later improves the family-bound repair gate and visible west-road posture.

branches.actor_intent: Earn voluntary glassback heat contribution through grooming and calm route handling.
state_basis: Glassbacks share stored heat and respond to parasite removal and respectful body spacing.
reviewed_consequences: Raises herd_trust, dependent_reserve, and pulse_integrity; later strengthens herd testimony and the reserve-bridge ending.

branches.actor_intent: Spend portable salt to strengthen the light-and-sugar side of the pulse circuit.
state_basis: Prismwake mats and lantern trees exchange light, minerals, route access, and stored sugars with nearby partners.
reviewed_consequences: Raises lantern_reserve and pulse_integrity while spending salt_stock; later changes lighting, shelter margin, and reserve availability.

branches.actor_intent: Spend time auditing promised inputs and care claims before allocating the basin.
state_basis: Portable archives expose selected provenance, obligations, and witness traces without surrendering all family memory.
reviewed_consequences: Raises evidence_chain and caretaker_legitimacy while increasing route_delay; later supports plural-debt allocation and narrows the light window.

branches.actor_intent: Request a bounded archive disclosure that distinguishes rescue work from the unpaid deficit.
state_basis: Varo controls the private family archive and can expose one selected layer.
The open layer can prove conduct without producing missing matter.
reviewed_consequences: Raises evidence_chain, family_standing, and route_delay; later separates earned prestige from physical capacity.

branches.actor_intent: Ask the glassback herd for embodied route testimony without treating it as a commanded record.
state_basis: Glassback plates expose heat and memory gradients.
Herd trust governs how much detail it makes legible around calves.
reviewed_consequences: Raises herd_trust and route_delay, and raises evidence_chain by one or two according to prior herd trust.

branches.actor_intent: Cover the missing mineral share immediately from sealed commons stock.
state_basis: Tesh can open current stores but cannot erase their future care use.
reviewed_consequences: Spends salt_stock and dependent_reserve while raising road_credit and pulse_integrity; later may make the infant margin visibly unsafe.

branches.actor_intent: Pause the scheduled draw and invite voluntary repair contributions from every present family.
state_basis: The caretaker can open a public contribution process but cannot assign shared debt without consent.
reviewed_consequences: Sets shared_obligation, raises caretaker_legitimacy and route_delay, and lowers family_standing by making the prestigious shortage public.

branches.actor_intent: Delay elective reproductive use and preserve infant and infirm care first.
state_basis: Dependent care has priority over elective draws, but the decision needs actual reserve and steward legitimacy to avoid shrinking future support.
reviewed_consequences: Routes to dependent-baseline success or cost according to dependent_reserve and caretaker_legitimacy.

branches.actor_intent: Admit the scheduled draw while binding the beneficiary family to material route repairs.
state_basis: A repair promise can support a draw only when road credit, evidence, and current pulse capacity all exist.
reviewed_consequences: Routes to family-bound repair success or cost; success preserves the class ambiguity of earned contribution and inherited access.

branches.actor_intent: Distribute a voluntarily offered deficit across separate family route cords.
state_basis: Shared obligation must have been opened and visibly consented to before the archive can distribute it.
reviewed_consequences: Routes to shared-repair success or coercive assessment cost according to consent, legitimacy, and evidence.

branches.actor_intent: Spend accumulated ecological margin to complete dependent and scheduled draws in the current pulse.
state_basis: Heat or sugar margin, remaining salt, and intact pulse relations must coexist; separate thin margins cannot be declared into abundance.
reviewed_consequences: Routes to a one-cycle reserve bridge or a cascading overdraw according to dependent reserve, lantern reserve, salt, and pulse integrity.

audit.reviewer: Codex world worker applying the four named Ghostlight reviewer prompts as separate passes

findings_resolved: Split the extinguished-road and empty-packet reveal into its own shortfall_reveal knot so the pivotal resource failure has a distinct click-through screen.
Verified all eleven variables alter later prose, gates, risks, visible state, or endings and that all eight success-or-cost endings are reachable across the sixteen pre-final state combinations.
Kept Varo's rescue claim materially credible while making missing salt remain missing; the family advocate is pressured rather than flattened into a hoarder.
Added pulse-niche metabolism, draw accounting, dependent-care priority, class pressure, and cascade failure to the owning Breeding Grounds note as a plainly marked Ghostlight elaboration.
Removed a visual assumption that glassbacks have exactly four legs because the source establishes dorsal plates and herd behavior but not limb count.
Marked the pulse basin, heat braid, Four-Return geometry, named characters, exact reproduction procedure, and species arrangement as story-local or unresolved rather than universal canon.
Replaced a synthetic draw_arrival.shortfall sub-anchor with the real shortfall_reveal Ink knot.
Aligned northern ramp descent across Ink, visual plan, scene-set map, and BFL manifest.
Provided stable Sa'auei'a and herd refs, excluded the two off-frame family members, and supplied explicit modifiers for all routine, pressure, and ending branches.
reviewer_passes.remaining_condition: The embedded scene-set map supports draft illustrated replay; high-consistency multi-angle website art still requires a plan view or 3D blockout used as camera-specific visual input.

findings_resolved: Fixed a north-west-east-south apron coordinate frame with one central basin and named camera slots.
Added an east-to-south herd grazing loop and an explicit short guardian route for Oru's intervention at the central archive.
Tracked the draw token, selected family archive layer, sealed salt, and shared work packets through folded branches and outcome modifiers.

review_notes: Narrative review found no remaining major problem after the pivotal shortfall received its own knot; routine, pressure, and resolution remain legible without outside notes.
Lore review checked all sixteen cited vault sources and accepted the new economy as a bounded elaboration of the existing breeding-ground dependency web.
Visual review accepted prompt specificity, character visibility, segmentation, and branch deltas for B-level draft replay; rendering was explicitly deferred.
Spatial review accepted the stageable layout and branch-persistent object positions after the two missing movement routes were named.
